full_judgment: 10. In Jai Karan Vs. Panchaiti Akhara, Chow Nayan Udasi Nanak Shahi AIR 1933 Allahabad 49 (J), after hearing the arguments the learned Chief Justice dictated an order in the open Court. But immediately thereafter a request by one of the counsels of the parties that the judgment might not be signed so that the question of limitation arising in the case might further be considered was acceded to by the Court. The transcript of the judgment was, however, signed by inadvertence. Sulaiman, CJ set aside the order and reheard the matter. This was a case where a mistake committed by a functionary of the Court itself was later set right by the Court in its inherent jurisdiction.
